passages.title: Common Cold
passages.section: Summary · What is the common cold?
passages.text: The common cold is a mild infection of your upper respiratory tract (which includes your nose and throat).
passages.population: General patient education; displayed here for English-speaking adults.
passages.limitations: Definition only. This passage cannot distinguish a cold from other causes of respiratory symptoms.
passages.rights: US public-domain MedlinePlus topic summary or medical test text. Courtesy of MedlinePlus from the National Library of Medicine.

passages.title: Hay Fever
passages.text: Sneezing, often with a runny or clogged nose
passages.population: General patient education; displayed here for English-speaking adults.
passages.limitations: One symptom from the publisher’s list. Seasonal exposure and an individual diagnosis are not established by this excerpt.
passages.rights: US public-domain MedlinePlus topic summary or medical test text. Courtesy of MedlinePlus from the National Library of Medicine.

passages.title: Migraine
passages.text: Migraines are a recurring type of headache. They cause moderate to severe pain that is throbbing or pulsing.
passages.population: General patient education; displayed here for English-speaking adults.
passages.limitations: Describes a migraine pattern. A first, sudden or different headache needs its own assessment.
passages.rights: US public-domain MedlinePlus topic summary or medical test text. Courtesy of MedlinePlus from the National Library of Medicine.

passages.title: Symptoms & Causes of Gas in the Digestive Tract
passages.text: Bloating is a feeling of fullness or swelling in your abdomen, or belly.
passages.publisher: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
passages.population: General patient education; displayed here for English-speaking adults.
passages.limitations: Defines the sensation. It cannot identify the cause of abdominal pain or establish measured distention.
passages.rights: NIDDK agency-authored patient information. The agency permits credited reproduction of this unmodified text.

passages.title: Balance Disorders
passages.text: A balance disorder is a condition that makes you feel unsteady or dizzy.
passages.publisher: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders
passages.population: General patient education; displayed here for English-speaking adults.
passages.limitations: A broad definition. There are many other possible causes of dizziness; it provides no diagnosis or urgency classification.
passages.rights: US public-domain NIDCD agency text under the publisher’s copyright policy.

passages.title: Urinary Tract Infections
passages.section: Summary · You may have a UTI if you notice
passages.text: Pain or burning when you urinate
passages.population: General patient education; displayed here for English-speaking adults.
passages.limitations: One possible symptom. This excerpt cannot determine whether an infection is present or interpret a urine test.
